items.prompt: Why can a valid blotter that starts and ends flat compute this task's PnL without an ending market mark?

options.text: There is no residual inventory to value.
options.why: Under the no-fee/no-other-flow assumptions, sale proceeds minus all purchase costs closes the cash calculation.

options.text: Every sale price is guaranteed to exceed its buy price.
options.why: Ending flat does not imply a profitable trade.

options.text: All purchase costs can be ignored once a sale occurs.
options.why: Profit is proceeds less costs, not proceeds alone.

options.text: The current market price is always equal to the last fill.
options.why: The task does not assume a future or current mark at the last traded price.

items.explanation: Under the no-fee/no-other-flow assumptions, sale proceeds minus all purchase costs closes the cash calculation.
